cds.title: University of South Carolina Columbia Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

scorecard.title: College Scorecard (location, enrollment, cost; data released 2026-10-15)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set 2025-26 (fall 2025 entering class): 59,630 applied, 33,695 admitted (56.5%), 7,818 enrolled; residency rows (in-state / out-of-state / international) add up to the totals. International (nonresident) first-years: 617 applied, 430 admitted (70%), 63 enrolled. Waitlist: 8,805 offered a place, 3,395 accepted, 293 admitted. Undergraduate enrollment (31,845) is B1 'Total all undergraduates' and the 488 nonresident count is the 'Total Undergraduates' column of B2. 32% of enrolled first-years submitted SAT scores and 15% ACT (the application is test-optional). The GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled students' column; the average of 3.68 matches that distribution on a 4.0 scale. Early action only, no early decision. Values were read from the PDF's form-field data (the text layer shows tables misaligned) and cross-checked against the printed totals.

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs for 2026-27 from the Common Data Set 2025-26, section G: in-state tuition $12,288, out-of-state tuition $38,098 (international students are nonresidents; the CDS gives one out-of-state figure), required fees $400, on-campus food and housing $17,334 (housing $11,432 + food $5,902). Estimated expenses: books $1,522, transportation $2,670, other $4,790 (other shown = transportation + other). Per CDS H6, institutional non-need-based aid is available to nonresident undergraduates and need-based aid is not: 142 degree-seeking nonresidents received institutional aid, average $32,670 (total $4,639,116); the CDS lists 'applications specific to institutional scholarships' as the form nonresident first-years file.
